name.description: Kebab-case page and feature name. Required unless --document is given; defaults to the dasherized node id.

path.description: Feature directory within the selected application source root.

project.description: Angular application project. Required when the workspace has multiple applications.

routePath.description: URL path for the lazy route. Defaults to the page name. Not allowed with --document.

access.description: Route access mode. Defaults to public. Protected routes require an already-configured reusable auth guard. Not allowed with --document.

authGuard.description: Existing locally imported auth-guard identifier used by protected routes. Defaults to authGuard. Not allowed with --document.

navigationLabel.description: Navigation label stored in route data. Defaults to the classified page name. Not allowed with --document.

navigationIcon.description: Optional Material icon name stored in route navigation data. Not allowed with --document.

document.description: Workspace-relative path to a canonical OpenUI JSON document (*.openui.json or *.json). Compiles a DashboardPage or EmptyPage node: [title], [route], [icon], [access], and [authGuard] come from the node, and DashboardPage children are compiled and embedded into the page.

nodeId.description: Optional element ID within the OpenUI document to compile. When omitted, targets the first DashboardPage or EmptyPage element. Requires --document.
